rows.text: IPU's summary of the 2005 elections states: 'On 23 March, the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly, Hon. Veikune (see note below), issued an election order for by-elections for the four seats vacated by the newly appointed ministers'.
rows.uncertainty: IPU corroboration only: an interparliamentary summary whose listed sources are the Electoral Supervisor of the Government of Tonga (20.07.2005), the Government of Tonga (www.pmo.gov.to) and a Tongan news website; not a Tongan record.

rows.text: IPU's note and comments state that Mr. Veikune lost his post as Speaker following his conviction on 25 January 2006 and that King Taufa'ahau Tupou IV consented to the appointment of Mr. Tu'iha'angana as the new Speaker of the Legislative Assembly '(effective from 10 February 2006)'.
rows.locator: Note under the background paragraph; 'Comments' under the results
rows.uncertainty: IPU corroboration only. attested_on is the effective date IPU states, not the day of the royal consent, which IPU does not give. No Tongan royal instrument, Palace or PMO release for this appointment was found, so no Tu'iha'angana holder is created from it.

bounded_scope: Speaker observations for CLAUDE-C01-24 only (role to_speaker on the to_legislative_assembly observation).
